title: With late teammates in mind, Ateneo has rousing UAAP Season 89 debut

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Playing the first game of the tournament dedicated to its fallen teammates Divine Adili and Rene Baterbonia, the Ateneo opened UAAP Season 89 with a rousing 101-74 win over University of the East on Wednesday at Mall of Asia Arena. With Adili’s parents in attendance, the Blue Eagles pulled away in the second quarter and never looked back.
